//: Full MCP catalog (Windows). Copy to a project root as .mcp.json, then DELETE the servers you don't need. Running >5 active servers degrades tool selection. Servers needing a key won't start until you set the env var.

context7.//: Up-to-date, version-specific library docs. No key. Highly recommended.

playwright.//: Browser automation + E2E testing via accessibility tree. No key.

sequential-thinking.//: Structured multi-step reasoning for hard problems. No key.

github.//: GitHub API: PRs, issues, repos. Needs a Personal Access Token.

memory.//: Knowledge-graph memory. Overlaps with claude-mem; pick ONE. No key.

filesystem.//: Extra filesystem access scoped to given roots. Edit the path. No key.

exa.//: Web/code search (hosted). May require an Exa account/key on their side.

deepwiki.//: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo's docs. No key.
